dailyMix: 4 high-performance carousels a day from playbook.weeklyRotation. NO REELS (owner rule, reconfirmed 22 Oct). KIDS daily at 19:00.
designRules: Renderer v2 (premium). Read the header comment of render.py for all slide types. Non-mega covers MUST set art (sql|powerbi|python|excel|roadmap|career) and badge (e.g. '30 Q&A'); mega posts start with marker_cover instead. Put exactly one accent word in ~tildes~ (serif italic) in cover, list and CTA titles (marker_cover too: it renders as a yellow highlighter swipe). Every list slide gets a tag and a punchy title. Max 3 text items or 2 code items per list slide. Roadmaps use timeline slides (2 phases per slide). Use table slides for numeric comparisons and compare slides for do/don't. CTA slides must set keyword. Code lines 38 chars max. Renderer v3: marker covers fan the first 3 inside pages, carry a sticker with the real PDF page count (spec.sticker overrides) and a 'Comment KEYWORD for the PDF' chip; split slides render as two cards with a VS medallion; every page has a progress bar and page counter.
pdfRule: Render with: python3 render.py spec.json outN --pdf. The PDF sits next to the slides in posts/<date>/<slug>/carousel.pdf and is served by the local desk. The PDF = all slides + a clickable product page for the 90-Day System (topmate.io/abhishek_kumar1085/1990922). CTA and caption must promise exactly this: 'Comment <KEYWORD> and I'll DM you ... as a PDF.' Never promise extra content that isn't in the PDF.
productRule: render.py auto-inserts a styled 90-Day System pitch slide before the CTA in every post (4 phases, 27 projects, 100+ Q&As, 365-day mentor access). Never mention the price anywhere (slides, captions, PDFs). Add the line 'Want the complete 90-day system? Link in bio.' before the keyword CTA in every caption.
styleRule: NO DARK THEMES (owner rule, 27 Sep 2026): every slide, cover, CTA, product page and cover_alt must have a light background; no dark cards, dark code windows or dark panels. The renderer's 4 styles (ember, mist, terracotta, paper) are all light; 'midnight' is a legacy alias for mist. Set spec.style on every post. The 3 non-mega posts of a day each use a different style, and a slot does not repeat yesterday's style. Mega posts always use style paper. All slides inside one post share one style. Never add a theme:'ink' or any dark override.
